book.name: DIR PASA
book.title: DIR PASA Dir pasa Yesus Kristusŋge te-mayokna

content: Kile ye kiŋatanu suk eŋel ande samba mbolŋge ndekina le kaŋgeren. Nu ma buto sinam nzi tuku ki le sen muli suŋgo kile ŋak minna.
Nu ndek mbeŋ o buk abo abo minna ta nyunu bukla ŋayonu nyunu ande Satan nu biye timba ndaleka
nu yar 1,000 kilke mbol mbal yabri ndaniŋguwa ŋga nu tumba ma buto sinam nziŋge bukŋga malaŋga su ndiŋna le minna. Yar 1,000 ta kugawaig le nu maŋ mayok ka ait fagnu ndo taŋgo yabriniŋgamŋgat.

Ye maŋ mambilmba minyo mbili maditaknu afu kaŋgerken. Nane minyo mbili kame ta mbolŋge minyokinaig mbal Kuateŋge nyu niŋgina le nane afu pasa mbolŋge patika pileniŋginaig. Kile ye kuasmbi afu turmba kaŋgerken ta nane buk kilke mbolŋge minmba Kuate tuku pasa Yesus tuku pasa tugusek kuklimba saka minnaig le afuŋge nane tuku ŋinfok kat purkinaig le kumnaig. Nane naŋgine tumail ko wai mbolŋge agaŋmor ŋguikok tuku suku kuyar ta kugatok. Nane nu tuku kanunu mata mbariŋ ndanaig tuku. Kile nane aboŋga Kristus ndoŋ gabat sugo minmba kuasmbi afu kulatka minnaig le yar 1,000 kinaig.
Nane kumanu mbal ŋgamukŋge nane amboŋga aboŋga tiŋginaig. Kumanu mbal afu nane yar 1,000 ta kugawaig le ndo nane aboŋga tiŋgamŋgaig.

Nane afu amboŋga aboŋga tiŋgamŋgaig mbal ta nane gare suŋgo tamŋgaig. Nane Kuate tuku mbal. Nane kume arnu ta te nda. Nane pris taŋaŋ Kuate le Kristus tuku piro biymba Kristus ndoŋ gabat sugo minmba yar 1,000 kuasmbi afu kulatkamŋgaig.
Yar 1,000 ta kugawaig le eŋel andeŋge malaŋga talka Satan kukliwa le maŋ mayok kaŋgat.
Nu mayok ka kilke tugu ŋakmba yabriniŋgamŋgat. Taŋamba nu Gok le Magok mbal kame buwam tuku kile-maŋgurkamŋgat. Maŋgur suŋgo ta fulbul taŋaŋ burnu kumuŋ kuga.

Nane kupe bukŋga ma tugu ŋakmba mbol kumba ka Kuate tuku mbal minig ma ta kormba tumbraŋ suŋgo Kuate nuŋe kume purte ta turmba koramŋgaig. Korwaig le samba mbolŋge pa suŋgo ndeka nane uge suluwamŋgaig.

Satan nu taŋgo yabriniŋmba minna ta Kuateŋge nu tumba bukŋguwa le pa bulu pa soŋ paknu kule kualiŋ suk ma ta mbol kaŋgat. Agaŋmor ŋguikok nale yabri tuan taŋgo ndoŋ nale mata pa ndui ta sinamŋge minamŋgaik. Nane furir ki mindek rar suŋgo tumba minmba minamŋgaig.
Kile ye kiŋatanu suk minyo mbili suŋgokanu maditaknu kaukauk Suŋgo nu ta mbolŋge minyok minna le kaŋgeren. Kilke le samba nu tumailamŋge mine ndaka kua ka ka ŋgisikinaik.

Ye mambilmba kumanu mbal nyu ŋak nyu kugatok nane ŋakmba minyo mbili suŋgo tumailamŋge tiŋ minnaig le kaŋgerken. Nane afu yu sinamŋge kumnaig ta ŋakmba tiŋginaig. Afu kummba kumanu mbal tuku tumbraŋŋge minnaig ta mata tiŋginaig. Nane ŋakmba tiŋginaig le Kuate nu ndek waŋe afu talke likina sulumba waŋe ande minmba minam tuku mbal tuku nyu ŋak ta turmba talkina. Kumanu mbal ŋakmba tiŋginaig le naŋgine wam ke likanu waŋe ta mbolŋge minnaig le kaŋgerka kumumbi pileniŋgina.
Kile Kuate nu kume maŋau le kumanu mbal tuku tumbraŋ ta kilmba pa mbol pankina. Pa suŋgo kule kualiŋ suk ta kume arnu.
Nane afu minmba minam tuku nyu waŋe mbolŋge mine ndakinaig ta ŋakmba kilmba pa suŋgo mbolŋge pankina.
